description.zh: 控制策略中的运维审批配置。
description.en: The O\&M approval setting in the control policy.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 可通过调用DescribeInstances接口获取堡垒机实例ID。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定需要修改的控制策略ID。
> 您可以调用[ListPolicies](~~2758876~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

> You can call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to query the control policy ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 设置指定控制策略的运维审批配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-approval-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 7 --approval-config SwitchStatus=On --region cn-hangzhou
